+## [1.6.3] - 2026-05-02
+
+> **Nota de reconciliacao (Auditor C2.1):** esta versao consolida DUAS
+> mudancas que foram implementadas em paralelo no ciclo 2 sobre `phase7-cutover.sh`:
+> (a) novo step 1e (Impl C2.1) e (b) validacao regex dos prefixos de uploads
+> em `resolve_cf_oac_swap_auto()` (Impl C2.3, originalmente bumpada como 1.6.2).
+> Ambas coexistem no arquivo final; 1.6.2 ficou como bump intermediario logico,
+> e 1.6.3 e o estado publicado. Veja entries dedicadas abaixo.
+
+### Added
+
+- `phase7-cutover.sh` (1.6.2 -> 1.6.3): novo step **1e** — `aws s3 sync` via SSH
+  do prefixo de prod (`s3://...prd-sa/assets/uploads/`) para o filesystem local
+  da green (`/var/www/${FQDN}/wp-content/uploads/`). Roda apos o swap S3
+  (step 1d) e antes do register no prod-tg (step 2). Mesmo gate dos demais
+  steps CF-OAC (`CF_OAC_SWAP=true`).
+  - Filtro: `--include='*.svg' --include='*.png' --include='*.jpg' --include='*.jpeg' --include='*.webp' --include='*.gif'` — nao toca CSS de cache do Elementor.
+  - Idempotente: `--size-only` nao re-baixa; sem `--delete` (nao destrutivo).
+  - `chown www-data:www-data` pos-sync para garantir leitura por PHP-FPM.
+  - Falha graciosa: warning + return 0 (nao aborta cutover).
+  - State: `phases.phase7_cutover.details.step_1e_completed_at` +
+    `cutover.uploads_fs_sync_count`.

Falhava no cenario tunnel: home_url()\n  retorna cambrasmax.local mas tunnel-url-rewrite ja reescreveu URL para\n  concertacao.bureau-it.com → hosts diferem → URL com host do tunnel\n  era embutida no CSS estatico, contaminando acessos pelo local.\n\n  Fix: heuristica por path em vez de host. Se path contem\n  /wp-content/uploads/ → corta host (path estavel entre todos hosts\n  do site). Hosts externos genuinos (S3, CDN) nao terao esse path.\n\nv2.1.2 — perf cache estatico do backtrace caller-detect\n  bit_elc_caller_is_elementor_files() e _css_render() chamavam\n  debug_backtrace(IGNORE_ARGS, 20-25) a cada wp_get_attachment_url\n  — em listing JetEngine com 50-100 attachments somava 50-200ms TTFB.\n\n  Fix: cache estatico por request keyed por hash dos 8 frames topo\n  (3 frames era insuficiente — causou regressao de URLs absolutas).\n  PHP-FPM workers reciclam estaticos a cada request — sem cross-request\n  pollution. Funcionalidade preservada (URLs continuam path-relative).\n\nNovo helper: docker-dev/common/scripts/elementor-cache-rebuild.sh v1.0.0\n  Automatiza limpeza+regen+warm de cache CSS Elementor. ### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  const ctx = page.context();
  await ctx.setExtraHTTPHeaders({});
  await ctx.clearCookies();

  const pages = {
    home:    'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/',
    atlas_pt:'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/',
    atlas_en:'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/en/cultural-atlas-of-the-amazon/',
    espiral: 'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/conhecimento/espiral-de-conhecimento/',
    eventos: 'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/eventos-calendario/',
  };

  const results = {};
  for (const [key, url] of Object.entries(pages)) {
    const cache404s = [];
    page.removeAllListeners('response');
    page.on('response', (resp) => {
      const u = resp.url();
      if (resp.status() === 404 && u.includes('elementor-cache')) {
        cache404s.push(u.substring(u.indexOf('elementor-cache')));
      }
    });
    try {
      await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
      const data = await page.evaluate(async () => {
        let hostname = 'unknown';
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/check-ec2.php?cb=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });
          const text = await r.text();
          hostname = (text.match(/Hostname:\s*([^\n<]+)/) || [])[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';
        } catch(e){}
        const jsf = window.JetSmartFilterSettings?.props || {};
        const allFoundPosts = [];
        for (const provider in jsf) for (const qid in jsf[provider]) {
          allFoundPosts.push({ k: provider + '/' + qid, v: jsf[provider][qid].found_posts });
        }
        const cssLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]'));
        return {
          hostname,
          title: document.title,
          html_size: document.documentElement.outerHTML.length,
          stylesheets: cssLinks.length,
          uploads_elementor_css: cssLinks.filter(l => /\/uploads\/(?:sites\/\d+\/)?elementor\//.test(l.href)).length,
          jet_max_found_posts: Math.max(0, ...allFoundPosts.map(o => o.v || 0)),
          listing_items: document.querySelectorAll('.jet-listing-grid__item').length,
        };
      });
      results[key] = { ...data, elementor_cache_404s: cache404s.length };
    } catch (e) {
      results[key] = { error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 120) };
    }
  }
  return results;
})(page);
```

```js
await (async (page) => {
  const ctx = page.context();
  await ctx.setExtraHTTPHeaders({});
  await ctx.clearCookies();

  // Re-test eventos com handler de download
  let eventos = {};
  try {
    const downloadPromise = page.context().waitForEvent('page', { timeout: 1 }).catch(()=>{});
    await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/eventos-calendario/', {
      waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000
    });
    eventos = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      let hostname = 'unknown';
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/check-ec2.php?cb=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });
        hostname = ((await r.text()).match(/Hostname:\s*([^\n<]+)/) || [])[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';
      } catch(e){}
      return {
        hostname,
        title: document.title,
        html_size: document.documentElement.outerHTML.length,
        tribe_events: document.querySelectorAll('.tribe-events-calendar-month__day').length || document.querySelectorAll('.tribe-common-g-row').length,
      };
    });
  } catch (e) { eventos = { error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 100) }; }

  // Form Newsletter (home footer)
  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  const newsletter = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const forms = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('form.elementor-form, form.jet-form, form[name]'));
    const newsletterForms = forms.filter(f => {
      const html = f.outerHTML.toLowerCase();
      return /newsletter|email/i.test(html) && !!f.querySelector('input[type=email]');
    });
    return newsletterForms.map(f => {
      const fields = Array.from(f.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea'))
        .filter(el => !['hidden','submit'].includes(el.type));
      const submitBtn = f.querySelector('button[type=submit], input[type=submit]');
      return {
        form_id: f.id || f.getAttribute('name') || '?',
        fields_count: fields.length,
        fields_sample: fields.slice(0,4).map(el => ({ type: el.type || el.tagName.toLowerCase(), placeholder: el.placeholder || null })),
        submit_label: submitBtn?.innerText?.trim() || submitBtn?.value || null,
      };
    });
  });

  // Form Contato
  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/contato/?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  const contato = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const forms = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('form.elementor-form, form.jet-form, form[name]'))
      .filter(f => f.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=hidden]), textarea').length >= 3);
    return forms.map(f => {
      const fields = Array.from(f.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea'))
        .filter(el => !['hidden','submit'].includes(el.type));
      const submitBtn = f.querySelector('button[type=submit], input[type=submit]');
      return {
        form_id: f.id || f.getAttribute('name') || '?',
        fields_count: fields.length,
        fields_sample: fields.map(el => ({ type: el.type || el.tagName.toLowerCase(), placeholder: el.placeholder || null })),
        submit_label: submitBtn?.innerText?.trim() || submitBtn?.value || null,
      };
    });
  });

  return { eventos, newsletter, contato };
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  // Paths principais do menu (excluindo cultura/linha-do-tempo subpages e estudos individuais)
  const paths = [
    '/atuacao/',
    '/atuacao/iniciativas-estruturantes/',
    '/atuacao/grupos-de-trabalho/',
    '/atuacao/encontros/',
    '/atuacao/atuacao-internacional/',
    '/atuacao/faq/',
    '/conhecimento/',
    '/conhecimento/espiral-de-conhecimento/',
    '/conhecimento/mapa-das-plataformas/',
    '/conhecimento/publicacoes/',
    '/conhecimento/entrevistas/',
    '/agenda-integradora/',
    '/agenda-geral/',
    '/contato/',
    '/cultura/',
    '/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/',
    '/aviso-de-privacidade/',
  ];

  const measurePage = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    try {
      const resp = await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(800);
      return await page.evaluate((status) => {
        const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3'))
          .map(h => h.innerText.trim().slice(0, 60))
          .filter(Boolean);
        const downloadBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a, button'))
          .filter(b => /download/i.test(b.innerText || ''))
          .map(b => b.innerText.trim().slice(0, 30));
        const imgsRendered = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img'))
          .filter(i => i.naturalWidth >= 100).length;
        return {
          status,
          page_height: document.body.scrollHeight,
          heading_count: headings.length,
          download_btn_count: downloadBtns.length,
          rendered_images: imgsRendered,
          elementor_sections: document.querySelectorAll('.elementor-section, .e-con').length,
          headings_signature: headings.slice(0, 10).join('|').slice(0, 200),
        };
      }, resp ? resp.status() : 0);
    } catch (e) {
      return { error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 80), status: 0 };
    }
  };

  const results = [];
  for (const path of paths) {
    const prod = await measurePage('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br' + path);
    const dev  = await measurePage('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com' + path);

    if (prod.error || dev.error || !prod.headings_signature || !dev.headings_signature) {
      results.push({
        path,
        prod_status: prod.status,
        dev_status: dev.status,
        verdict: prod.status !== 200 && dev.status === 200 ? 'FAIL: prod-down' :
                 dev.status !== 200 ? 'WARN: dev-down' : 'ERROR',
      });
      continue;
    }

    const headingsMatch = prod.headings_signature === dev.headings_signature;
    const heightDiffPct = Math.round(Math.abs(prod.page_height - dev.page_height) / Math.max(prod.page_height, dev.page_height) * 100);
    const imagesDiffPct = Math.round(Math.abs(prod.rendered_images - dev.rendered_images) / Math.max(prod.rendered_images, dev.rendered_images, 1) * 100);
    const sectionsDiff  = prod.elementor_sections - dev.elementor_sections;
    const btnsDiff      = prod.download_btn_count - dev.download_btn_count;

    const fails = [];
    if (!headingsMatch)              fails.push('headings');
    if (heightDiffPct > 15)          fails.push(`Δh=${heightDiffPct}%`);
    if (imagesDiffPct > 30)          fails.push(`Δimg=${imagesDiffPct}%`);
    if (Math.abs(sectionsDiff) > 2)  fails.push(`Δsec=${sectionsDiff}`);
    if (btnsDiff !== 0)              fails.push(`Δbtns=${btnsDiff}`);

    results.push({
      path,
      prod_status: prod.status, dev_status: dev.status,
      prod_h: prod.heading_count, dev_h: dev.heading_count,
      prod_height: prod.page_height, dev_height: dev.page_height,
      Δh_pct: heightDiffPct, Δimg_pct: imagesDiffPct, Δsec: sectionsDiff,
      verdict: fails.length === 0 ? 'PASS' : `FAIL: ${fails.join(', ')}`,
    });
  }

  return {
    total: paths.length,
    pass: results.filter(r => r.verdict === 'PASS').length,
    fail: results.filter(r => r.verdict.startsWith('FAIL')).length,
    error: results.filter(r => r.verdict === 'ERROR' || r.verdict.startsWith('WARN')).length,
    results,
  };
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  // ==== INVESTIGAÇÃO 1: /agenda-geral/ — entender Δimg=62% ====
  const inspect = async (url, label) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
    // Scroll para o fundo pra disparar lazy-load
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight));
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);

    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const imgs = Array.from(document.images);
      const grouped = {
        total: imgs.length,
        rendered_100plus: imgs.filter(i => i.naturalWidth >= 100).length,
        rendered_any: imgs.filter(i => i.naturalWidth > 0).length,
        broken: imgs.filter(i => i.complete && i.naturalWidth === 0).length,
        loading_lazy: imgs.filter(i => i.loading === 'lazy').length,
        no_src: imgs.filter(i => !i.src).length,
        elementor_in_alt: imgs.filter(i => /uploads/.test(i.src)).length,
      };
      const samples = imgs.slice(0, 8).map(i => ({
        src: (i.src || '').substring((i.src || '').lastIndexOf('/') + 1).slice(0, 50),
        nw: i.naturalWidth,
        loading: i.loading,
        complete: i.complete,
      }));
      return { grouped, samples };
    });
  };

  const prod = await inspect('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/agenda-geral/', 'PROD');
  const dev  = await inspect('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/agenda-geral/', 'DEV');

  return { prod, dev };
})(page);

🎯 **Falso positivo do gate Δimg=62%!** Após scroll completo:

| Métrica | PROD | DEV | Análise |
|---------|------|-----|---------|
| Total imagens | 16 | 16 | **idêntico** |
| Renderizadas (≥100px) | **13** | **13** | **idêntico** |
| Renderizadas (any) | 15 | 15 | idêntico |
| Quebradas | 0 | 0 | idêntico |
| `loading="lazy"` | **14** | **2** | ⚠️ diferença real |

A diferença de 62% no smoke original era **timing** — PROD tem `loading="lazy"` em mais imagens (WP Rocket Lazy Load ativado no servidor), então no momento do snapshot do snippet (sem scroll), menos imagens estavam renderizadas. **Após scroll**, ambos têm 13 imagens carregadas.

**Veredito**: Não é regressão, é diferença de configuração de lazy-load — PROD agressivo (correto pra performance), DEV permissivo. Posso adicionar `scroll-to-bottom` no snippet do `/smoke` pra eliminar esse falso-positivo.

  "new_string": "  const measurePage = async (url) => {\n    await page.context().clearCookies();\n    // Fix 4 — Capturar erros de console + 4xx/5xx em recursos.\n    // Detecta JS errors (TypeError, ReferenceError) e assets quebrados que nao\n    // aparecem na altura/headings mas indicam regressao funcional.\n    const consoleErrors = [];\n    const failedResources = [];\n    const consoleHandler = (msg) => {\n      if (msg.type() === 'error') {\n        consoleErrors.push(msg.text().slice(0, 160));\n      }\n    };\n    const responseHandler = (resp) => {\n      if (resp.status() >= 400 && resp.status() < 600) {\n        const u = resp.url();\n        // Ignorar assets externos (CDN, ads, analytics) — só interessa o proprio site\n        if (u.includes('concertacaoamazonia.com.br') || u.includes('concertacao.bureau-it.com') || u.includes('cambrasmax.local')) {\n          failedResources.push(`${resp.status()} ${u.substring(u.lastIndexOf('/')+1).slice(0, 60)}`);\n        }\n      }\n    };\n    page.on('console', consoleHandler);\n    page.on('response', responseHandler);\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });\n      await page.waitForTimeout(1500);\n\n      // Fix 3 — Aceitar cookie banner Complianz (PT/EN) consistentemente em ambos\n      // Banner aparecendo em um e não em outro causa altura diferente (falso positivo gate 13).\n      await page.evaluate(() => {\n        const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a'));\n        const acceptBtn = btns.find(b => /aceitar|accept|allow/i.test(b.innerText || '') && b.offsetWidth > 0);\n        if (acceptBtn) acceptBtn.click();\n      });\n      await page.waitForTimeout(500);"

```js
await (async (page) => {
  // ==== FASE 8 — Warm-up do menu PROD ====
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
  const menuUrls = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const sels = ['header nav a[href]', '.elementor-nav-menu a[href]', 'nav.elementor-nav-menu--main a[href]', '.elementor-location-header a[href]'];
    const set = new Set();
    sels.forEach(s => document.querySelectorAll(s).forEach(a => {
      const href = a.href || '';
      if (!href || href.startsWith('javascript:') || href.startsWith('mailto:') || href.startsWith('tel:')) return;
      if (!href.startsWith('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/')) return;
      const clean = href.split('#')[0].split('?')[0];
      if (clean === 'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/' || clean === 'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br') return;
      // Pular eventos individuais
      if (clean.includes('/event/')) return;
      set.add(clean);
    }));
    return [...set].slice(0, 15);
  });

  const results = [];
  for (const url of menuUrls) {
    try {
      // 1ª visita (warm-up — descartado)
      await page.goto(url + '?cb=warm' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 25000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(300);
      // 2ª visita (medição — deveria bater cache)
      const t0 = Date.now();
      const resp = await page.goto(url + '?cb=measure' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 25000 });
      const ttfb = Date.now() - t0;
      const headers = resp ? resp.headers() : {};
      results.push({
        url: url.replace('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br', ''),
        status: resp ? resp.status() : 0,
        ttfb_ms: ttfb,
        x_cache: headers['x-cache'] || null,
        age: headers['age'] || null,
        x_rocket_reason: headers['x-rocket-reason'] || null,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      results.push({
        url: url.replace('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br', ''),
        error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 80),
      });
    }
  }
  return { menu_count: menuUrls.length, items: results };
})(page);

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  // ==== FASE 1-4: Páginas críticas ====
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  const pages = {
    home:    'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/',
    atlas_pt:'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/',
    atlas_en:'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/en/cultural-atlas-of-the-amazon/',
    espiral: 'https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/conhecimento/espiral-de-conhecimento/',
  };
  const results = {};
  for (const [key, url] of Object.entries(pages)) {
    const cache404s = [];
    page.removeAllListeners('response');
    page.on('response', (resp) => {
      const u = resp.url();
      if (resp.status() === 404 && u.includes('elementor-cache')) {
        cache404s.push(u.substring(u.indexOf('elementor-cache')));
      }
    });
    try {
      await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 30000 });
      const data = await page.evaluate(async () => {
        let hostname = 'unknown';
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/check-ec2.php?cb=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });
          hostname = ((await r.text()).match(/Hostname:\s*([^\n<]+)/) || [])[1]?.trim() || 'unknown';
        } catch(e){}
        const jsf = window.JetSmartFilterSettings?.props || {};
        let max_found = 0;
        for (const provider in jsf) for (const qid in jsf[provider]) {
          const v = jsf[provider][qid].found_posts || 0;
          if (v > max_found) max_found = v;
        }
        return {
          hostname,
          jet_max_found_posts: max_found,
          listing_items: document.querySelectorAll('.jet-listing-grid__item').length,
          uploads_elementor_css: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')).filter(l => /\/uploads\/(?:sites\/\d+\/)?elementor\//.test(l.href)).length,
        };
      });
      results[key] = { ...data, elementor_cache_404s: cache404s.length };
    } catch (e) {
      results[key] = { error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 80) };
    }
  }
  return results;
})(page);
```

```js
await (async (page) => {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000); // tempo extra pra Complianz inicializar via JS

  return await page.evaluate(() => {
    // Procurar QUALQUER elemento com "cmplz" ou "complianz" ou "cookie" no HTML
    const all = document.body.innerHTML;
    const cmplzMatches = (all.match(/cmplz/gi) || []).length;
    const complianzMatches = (all.match(/complianz/gi) || []).length;

    // Listar elementos visíveis com "cookie" no class/id
    const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=cookie i], [id*=cookie i], [class*=cmplz i], [id*=cmplz i], [class*=complianz i]'))
      .map(el => ({
        tag: el.tagName,
        id: el.id || null,
        cls: el.className?.toString().slice(0, 100) || null,
        visible: getComputedStyle(el).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden',
        text: (el.innerText || '').slice(0, 80),
      }))
      .slice(0, 15);

    // Scripts loaded
    const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]'))
      .map(s => s.src.substring(s.src.lastIndexOf('/')+1).slice(0, 60))
      .filter(s => /complianz|cmplz|cookie|gdpr/i.test(s));

    // window.complianz?
    const windowComplianz = typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined' ? Object.keys(window.complianz || {}).slice(0,10) : null;
    const windowCmplz = typeof window.cmplz_settings !== 'undefined' ? Object.keys(window.cmplz_settings || {}).slice(0,10) : null;

    return {
      cmplz_html_matches: cmplzMatches,
      complianz_html_matches: complianzMatches,
      candidates_count: candidates.length,
      candidates_sample: candidates,
      complianz_scripts: scripts,
      window_complianz_keys: windowComplianz,
      window_cmplz_settings_keys: windowCmplz,
    };
  });
})(page);

1. WP Rocket excluiu CSS/JS do Complianz da minificação
2. Cache CloudFront cacheou versão pré-Complianz (antes da última config do plugin)
3. Plugin desativado via filtro/mu-plugin para usuário não-logado
4. Configuração regional (PT/BR) requer ativação manual do Complianz

  };
})(page);

<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: BIT Google Tag Manager
 * Plugin URI:  https://bureau-it.com
 * Description: Injeta o snippet do Google Tag Manager via constante GTM_CONTAINER_ID no wp-config.php.
 *              Funciona em multisite. Só ativa em WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE = 'production'.

 * Author:      Bureau de Tecnologia Ltda.

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

// Requer constante GTM_CONTAINER_ID definida no wp-config.php
if ( ! defined( 'GTM_CONTAINER_ID' ) || empty( GTM_CONTAINER_ID ) ) {
    return;
}

// Só injeta em produção
if ( function_exists( 'wp_get_environment_type' ) && wp_get_environment_type() !== 'production' ) {
    return;
}

/**
 * Snippet GTM no <head> (logo após <body> não é possível via WP hooks,
 * mas wp_head é o ponto correto para o script principal).
 */
add_action( 'wp_head', 'bit_gtm_head_snippet', 1 );
function bit_gtm_head_snippet() {
    $id = esc_attr( GTM_CONTAINER_ID );
    echo "<!-- Google Tag Manager -->\n";
    echo "<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':\n";
    echo "new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],\n";
    echo "j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;j.src=\n";
    echo "'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);\n";
    echo "})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','{$id}');</script>\n";
    echo "<!-- End Google Tag Manager -->\n";
}

/**
 * Noscript GTM logo após <body> via wp_body_open (WP 5.2+).

  const initial = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, #cmplz-cookiebanner-container, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
    const acceptBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, button.cmplz-accept-all, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]');
    const denyBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, button.cmplz-deny-all, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]');
    return {
      banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
      banner_text: banner?.innerText?.slice(0, 200) || null,
      has_accept: !!acceptBtn,
      accept_label: acceptBtn?.innerText?.trim() || null,
      has_deny: !!denyBtn,
      deny_label: denyBtn?.innerText?.trim() || null,

      window_cmplz: typeof window.cmplz !== 'undefined',
      cmplz_html_count: (document.body.innerHTML.match(/cmplz/gi) || []).length,
    };
  });

    if (btn) btn.click();
  });

  const afterAccept = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';').map(c => c.trim());
    const cmplzCookies = cookies.filter(c => c.startsWith('cmplz_'));
    const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).map(s => s.src);
    return {
      cmplz_cookies_count: cmplzCookies.length,
      cmplz_cookies_sample: cmplzCookies.slice(0, 6).map(c => c.split('=')[0]),
      gtm_loaded: scripts.some(s => /googletagmanager|gtag/.test(s)),
      ga_loaded: scripts.some(s => /google-analytics|stats\.g\.doubleclick/.test(s)),
      youtube_loaded: scripts.some(s => /youtube\.com\/iframe_api/.test(s)),
      rd_loaded: scripts.some(s => /d335luupugsy2|rdstation/.test(s)),
    };
  });

  // Reset + Negar
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const btn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, button.cmplz-deny-all, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]');

  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

    const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).map(s => s.src);
    return {
      gtm_present: scripts.some(s => /googletagmanager|gtag/.test(s)),
      ga_present: scripts.some(s => /google-analytics|stats\.g\.doubleclick/.test(s)),
      youtube_present: scripts.some(s => /youtube\.com\/iframe_api/.test(s)),
    };
  });

  return { initial, afterAccept, afterDeny };
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  const auditUrl = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, #cmplz-cookiebanner-container, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      const acceptBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, button.cmplz-accept-all, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]');
      const denyBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, button.cmplz-deny-all, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]');
      const cmplzScripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]'))
        .filter(s => /cmplz|complianz/i.test(s.src))
        .map(s => s.src.substring(s.src.lastIndexOf('/')+1).slice(0, 60));
      return {
        url: location.href,
        banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        has_accept: !!acceptBtn,
        has_deny: !!denyBtn,
        cmplz_html_count: (html.match(/cmplz-banner|cmplz-cookiebanner|cmplz-accept|cmplz-deny/gi) || []).length,
        cmplz_scripts_count: cmplzScripts.length,
        cmplz_scripts_sample: cmplzScripts,
        window_complianz: typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined',
      };
    });
  };

  return {
    blog1_root: await auditUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/'),
    blog2_cultura: await auditUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/'),
    blog2_atlas:   await auditUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/'),
  };
})(page);
```

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  // Ignorar erros de cert self-signed do dev
  const audit = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, #cmplz-cookiebanner-container, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
      const cmplzScripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]'))
        .filter(s => /cmplz|complianz/i.test(s.src))
        .map(s => s.src.substring(s.src.lastIndexOf('/')+1).slice(0, 50));
      return {
        url: location.href,
        banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        banner_text: banner?.innerText?.slice(0, 150) || null,
        has_accept: !!document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]'),
        has_deny:   !!document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]'),
        accept_label: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        deny_label: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        cmplz_html_count: (html.match(/cmplz-banner|cmplz-cookiebanner|cmplz-accept|cmplz-deny/gi) || []).length,
        cmplz_scripts_count: cmplzScripts.length,
        cmplz_scripts_sample: cmplzScripts.slice(0, 5),
        window_complianz: typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined',
        window_cmplz: typeof window.cmplz !== 'undefined',
      };
    });
  };
  return {
    blog1_dev:    await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/'),
    blog2_dev:    await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/cultura/'),
  };
})(page);
```

Auditoria DEV — descoberta importante:

| Local | banner | accept | deny | scripts cmplz | window.complianz | Status |
|-------|--------|--------|------|--------------:|------------------|--------|
| **Blog 1 dev** (`/`) | ✅ true | ✅ true | ✅ true | 1 (`complianz.js?ver=1774279960`) | ✅ true | ✅ |
| **Blog 2 dev** (`/cultura/`) | ❌ false | ❌ false | ❌ false | 0 | ❌ false | 🚨 |

🎯 **Diagnóstico claro:** sua configuração foi aplicada **somente no blog 1** (raiz). O blog 2 (`/cultura/`) ainda está sem o banner.

**Detalhes técnicos:**
- Blog 1: banner com texto correto em PT ("Gerenciar consentimento — Para proporcionar uma melhor experiência..."), botões "ACEITAR" e "REJEITAR"
- Console mostra `[LOG] opt-in @ ...complianz.js:1102` — plugin inicializa corretamente
- Blog 2: zero scripts Complianz carregados, `window.complianz === false` — config nunca aplicada

**Causa raiz**: WordPress Multisite com Complianz Network Active **exige configuração separada por subsite**. Cada blog tem seu próprio `cmplz_options` em `wp_2_options` (no caso do blog 2).

**Ação para corrigir:**
1. Login admin em `https://cambrasmax.local:8484/cultura/wp-admin/`
2. Menu **Complianz** → **Wizard**
3. Configurar região (BR), tipo de site, scripts categorizados
4. Salvar — option `cmplz_options` será criado em `wp_2_options`

Validação esperada após config: rodar Snippet 0 multisite do `/smoke` v5 → ambos blogs devem retornar `banner_visible: true`.

## ✅ Configurado corretamente (10 itens)

| Campo | Valor | OK porque |
|-------|-------|-----------|
| `regions` | `br` | LGPD é a lei aplicável ✅ |
| `country_company` | `BR` | Sede no Brasil ✅ |
| `cookie_banner_required` | `1` | Banner ativo ✅ |
| `enable_cookie_banner` | `yes` | Idem ✅ |
| `compile_statistics` | `google-tag-manager` | GTM identificado ✅ |
| `thirdparty_services_on_site` | `[google-recaptcha, youtube, google-maps, google-fonts, openstreetmaps]` | Lista correta ✅ |
| `socialmedia_on_site` | `[linkedin, instagram]` | OK (faltam Spotify, YouTube como social — ver abaixo) |
| `privacy-statement` / `cookie-statement` / `disclaimer` / `impressum` | `custom` | Páginas legais customizadas ✅ |
| `block_wordpress_comment_cookies` | `yes` | Privacidade comentários ✅ |
| `safe_mode` | `1` | Modo conservador ativo ✅ |

## ⚠️ Atenção (mas funcionando)

| Campo | Valor atual | Recomendação |
|-------|-------------|--------------|
| `compile_statistics_more_info_tag_manager` | `["accepted"]` | OK, mas pode ser refinado para listar **quais tags** estão dentro do GTM (GA4, Ads, etc) |
| `consent-mode` | `no` | **Considere ativar** se você usa Google Ads (Marina!) — habilita Consent Mode v2 do Google |
| `cmplz-gtag-ads_data_redaction` | `no` | Idem — em LGPD strict deveria ser `yes` |
| `self_host_google_fonts` | `self-host` | OK pra GDPR; em LGPD é menos crítico |
| `uses_ad_cookies` | `no` | ⚠️ Se você usa Google Ads (Marina), **deveria ser `yes`** |

## ❌ Faltando (preencher)

| Campo | Status | Por quê é importante |
|-------|--------|----------------------|
| `organization_name` / `organisation_name` | vazio | Nome da Concertação obrigatório no Cookie Policy / Privacy |
| `address_company` | vazio | Endereço da entidade na cookie policy |
| `email_company` | vazio | Email DPO/contato |
| `telephone_company` | vazio | Idem |
| `consenttype` | NÃO DEFINIDO | **Crítico** — define modelo de consent (opt-in vs opt-out vs implied). Para LGPD = `optin` |
| `other_region_behavior` / `other_region_behaviour` | NÃO DEFINIDO / `none` | Usuários fora do BR (EU vê site EN) precisam de consent GDPR também |
| `wizard_completed_once` | NÃO DEFINIDO | Indica que wizard não foi finalizado oficialmente — Complianz ainda mostra avisos no admin |

## 🚨 Problema crítico — Marina/Google Ads

- `compile_statistics: google-tag-manager` ✅
- `uses_ad_cookies: no` ❌ — **mas as campanhas Google Ad Grants estão ATIVAS** ⚠️
- `consent-mode: no` ❌ — sem Consent Mode v2, Google Ads perde tracking pós-LGPD

**Para a Marina poder rodar Google Ads dentro da LGPD**, você precisa:
1. `uses_ad_cookies = yes`
2. `consent-mode = yes`
3. `cmplz-gtag-ads_data_redaction = yes` (ou pelo menos `cmplz-gtag-urlpassthrough = yes`)

Sem isso, mesmo com Complianz instalado, o Google Ads não vai respeitar o consent do usuário corretamente — e isso pode penalizar conversões (downloads).

## Resumo

**Conquistas (Blog 1 dev):** região BR, GTM detectado, banner em PT, ACEITAR/REJEITAR funcionais, scripts terceiros catalogados.

**Gaps prioritários para corrigir antes de aplicar em PROD:**
1. **Aplicar config no Blog 2** (cultura) — fazer wizard `https://cambrasmax.local:8484/cultura/wp-admin/admin.php?page=cmplz-dashboard`
2. **Preencher dados da empresa** (`organization_name`, `address_company`, `email_company`)
3. **Setar `consenttype = optin`** (LGPD não permite implied/opt-out)
4. **Setar `uses_ad_cookies = yes`** + **`consent-mode = yes`** (crítico para Google Ad Grants funcionar)
5. **Definir `other_region_behavior`** (visitantes EU/UK do `/en/` precisam de consent GDPR)
6. **Finalizar wizard** (`wizard_completed_once`) para sumir avisos no admin

```js
await (async (page) => {
  const audit = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, #cmplz-cookiebanner-container, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML;
      return {
        banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        banner_text: banner?.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || null,
        accept_label: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        deny_label: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        cmplz_html_count: (html.match(/cmplz-banner|cmplz-cookiebanner|cmplz-accept|cmplz-deny/gi) || []).length,
        cmplz_scripts: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).filter(s => /cmplz|complianz/i.test(s.src)).length,
        window_complianz: typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined',
        // Verificar se Consent Mode v2 (Google Ads) está ativo
        gtag_consent_default: typeof window.gtag !== 'undefined' || (Array.isArray(window.dataLayer) && window.dataLayer.some(e => e[0] === 'consent')),
        datalayer_consent_events: Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)
          ? window.dataLayer.filter(e => Array.isArray(e) && e[0] === 'consent').map(e => ({mode: e[1], values: e[2]}))
          : [],
      };
    });
  };
  return {
    blog1: await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/'),
    blog2: await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/cultura/'),
  };
})(page);

await (async (page) => {
  const audit = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, #cmplz-cookiebanner-container, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      return {
        banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        banner_text: banner?.innerText?.slice(0, 100) || null,
        accept: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        deny: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        cmplz_scripts: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).filter(s => /cmplz|complianz/i.test(s.src)).length,
        window_complianz: typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined',
      };
    });
  };
  return {
    blog1: await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/'),
    blog2_cultura: await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/cultura/'),
    blog2_atlas: await audit('https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/'),
  };
})(page);

```js
await (async (page) => {
  const results = {};
  for (const [label, url] of [['blog1', 'https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/'], ['blog2', 'https://concertacao.bureau-it.com/cultura/']]) {
    const r = {};

    // ==== ACEITAR ====
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);

    r.banner_initial = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      return {
        visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        accept: !!document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]'),
        deny:   !!document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]'),
      };
    });

    // Clicar accept
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      const btn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]');
      if (btn) btn.click();
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);

    r.after_accept = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      const cookies = document.cookie.split(';').map(c => c.trim());
      const cmplzCookies = cookies.filter(c => c.startsWith('cmplz_'));
      const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).map(s => s.src);
      const datalayer = Array.isArray(window.dataLayer) ? window.dataLayer : [];
      const consentEvents = datalayer.filter(e => Array.isArray(e) && e[0] === 'consent');
      return {
        banner_hidden: banner ? (getComputedStyle(banner).display === 'none' || !document.contains(banner)) : true,
        cmplz_cookies: cmplzCookies.length,
        cmplz_cookies_sample: cmplzCookies.slice(0, 4).map(c => c.split('=')[0]),
        gtm_loaded: scripts.some(s => /googletagmanager|gtag/.test(s)),
        ga_loaded: scripts.some(s => /google-analytics|stats\.g\.doubleclick/.test(s)),
        consent_events_count: consentEvents.length,
        consent_events_sample: consentEvents.slice(0, 3).map(e => `${e[1]}: ${JSON.stringify(e[2]).slice(0, 80)}`),
      };
    });

    // ==== NEGAR (reset + clicar deny) ====
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);

    await page.evaluate(() => {
      const btn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]');
      if (btn) btn.click();
    });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);

    r.after_deny = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const cookies = document.cookie.split(';').map(c => c.trim());
      const cmplzCookies = cookies.filter(c => c.startsWith('cmplz_'));
      const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).map(s => s.src);
      const datalayer = Array.isArray(window.dataLayer) ? window.dataLayer : [];
      const consentEvents = datalayer.filter(e => Array.isArray(e) && e[0] === 'consent');
      return {
        cmplz_cookies: cmplzCookies.length,
        gtm_present: scripts.some(s => /googletagmanager|gtag/.test(s)),
        ga_present: scripts.some(s => /google-analytics|stats\.g\.doubleclick/.test(s)),
        youtube_present: scripts.some(s => /youtube\.com\/iframe_api/.test(s)),
        consent_events_count: consentEvents.length,
        consent_events_sample: consentEvents.slice(0, 3).map(e => `${e[1]}: ${JSON.stringify(e[2]).slice(0, 80)}`),
      };
    });

    results[label] = r;
  }
  return results;
})(page);

🚨 **Problema novo descoberto: GTM NÃO carrega NEM após aceitar**

**Análise:** O mu-plugin `bit-gtm.php` em **DEV não dispara** porque ele só ativa quando `WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE = 'production'` (ver código v1.0.0):

```php
if ( wp_get_environment_type() !== 'production' ) {
    return;
}
```

**Conclusão:** O dev é `development` (ou similar), então não é violação de LGPD — o GTM nunca seria injetado em dev mesmo sem Complianz. Em prod, com `WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE='production'`:
1. GTM dispara via `bit-gtm.php` no `wp_head`
2. Mas Complianz precisa **bloquear** esse GTM até consent (Cookie Blocker do Complianz reescreve `<script type="text/plain" data-cmplz-policy-id="...">`)
3. Após accept → Complianz libera o script → GTM carrega

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  const audit = async (url) => {
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(3500);
    return await page.evaluate(() => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
      return {
        banner_visible: banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' : false,
        banner_text: banner?.innerText?.slice(0, 100) || null,
        accept: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, [data-cmplz-action="accept"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        deny: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, [data-cmplz-action="deny"]')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        cmplz_scripts: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]')).filter(s => /cmplz|complianz/i.test(s.src)).length,
        window_complianz: typeof window.complianz !== 'undefined',
      };
    });
  };
  return {
    blog1_pt: await audit('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/'),
    blog1_en: await audit('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/en/'),
    blog2_pt: await audit('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/'),
    blog2_atlas: await audit('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/atlas-cultural-das-amazonias/'),
  };
})(page);
```

Tabela `wp_2_cmplz_cookiebanners` existe mas vazia, e o `save()` não persistiu. O método `save()` provavelmente espera um `ID` existente. Vou inserir diretamente via SQL clonando o blog 1:

> TOOL

tool_use Bash

```json
{
  "command": "cat > /tmp/cmplz-sql-clone.php << 'PHPEOF'\n<?php\nglobal $wpdb;\n\n// Pegar dados raw do banner blog 1\nswitch_to_blog(1);\n$src_table = $wpdb->prefix . \"cmplz_cookiebanners\";\n$src_row = $wpdb->get_row(\"SELECT * FROM $src_table WHERE ID = 1\", ARRAY_A);\necho \"Source row from blog 1, fields: \" . count($src_row) . PHP_EOL;\nrestore_current_blog();\n\n// Inserir em blog 2\necho \"Current blog: \" . get_current_blog_id() . PHP_EOL;\n$dst_table = $wpdb->prefix . \"cmplz_cookiebanners\";\necho \"Dst table: $dst_table\" . PHP_EOL;\n\nif ($src_row) {\n    unset($src_row[\"ID\"]); // auto-increment\n    $result = $wpdb->insert($dst_table, $src_row);\n    echo \"Insert result: \" . var_export($result, true) . PHP_EOL;\n    $new_id = $wpdb->insert_id;\n    echo \"New banner ID: $new_id\" . PHP_EOL;\n    if ($wpdb->last_error) echo \"Error: \" . $wpdb->last_error . PHP_EOL;\n}\n\n// Verificar\n$banners = cmplz_get_cookiebanners([\"status\" => \"all\"]);\necho PHP_EOL . \"Banners now: \" . count($banners) . PHP_EOL;\n}\n\n// Gerar CSS\nforeach ($banners as $b) {\n    $banner_obj = new CMPLZ_COOKIEBANNER($b->ID);\n    if (method_exists($banner_obj, \"generate_css\")) {\n        $banner_obj->generate_css();\n        echo \"  generate_css for {$b->ID} OK\" . > AGENT

Confirmado:
- `regions = 'br'` (apenas Brasil)
- `other_region_behavior = 'block'` (bloqueia outras regiões)
- `geoip = false` (sem geolocalização ativa)

Como `geoip` está desligado, Complianz não detecta região do visitante e usa fallback. Mas há um detalhe — o `other_region_behavior = 'block'` significa que para usuários FORA da região "br", o banner é bloqueado entirely.

Mudando para `'show'` (mostra o banner mesmo fora da região) faz mais sentido — visitantes EN também devem ver o banner LGPD por compliance internacional.

> TOOL

tool_use Bash
id: toolu_01SHaybuito2R988TDAAuCjW
```json
{
  "command": "cat > /tmp/cmplz-fix-en.php << 'PHPEOF'\n<?php\necho \"Current blog: \" . get_current_blog_id() . PHP_EOL;\necho \"BEFORE other_region_behavior: \" . cmplz_get_value(\"other_region_behavior\") . PHP_EOL;\n\n// Mudar para 'show' (mostra banner em todas regiões, não só BR)\nCOMPLIANZ::$config->update_field(\"other_region_behavior\", \"show\");\n\n// Forçar update das opções\n$options = get_option(\"complianz_options_settings\", []);\n$options[\"other_region_behavior\"] = \"show\";\nupdate_option(\"complianz_options_settings\", $options);\n\necho \"AFTER other_region_behavior: \" . cmplz_get_value(\"other_region_behavior\") . PHP_EOL;\n\n// Regenerar CSS\ncmplz_update_all_banners();\necho \"CSS regenerated\" . PHP_EOL;\nPHPEOF\n\nscp /tmp/cmplz-fix-en.php concertacaoamazonia.com.br-prod-sa:/tmp/ 2>&1 | tail -1\n# Aplicar em blog 1 e blog 2\nfor url in \"https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br\" \"https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura\"; do\n  echo \"=== $url ===\"\n  ssh concertacaoamazonia.com.br-prod-sa \"sudo -u www-data wp --path=/var/www/concertacaoamazonia.com.br --url=$url eval-file /tmp/cmplz-fix-en.php\" 2>&1 | grep -v \"Deprecated\"\ndone",
  "description": "Set other_region_behavior to show in both blogs prod"
}

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  const ctx = page.context();
  await ctx.clearCookies();

  const checkUrl = async (url, label) => {
    try {
      await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
      return await page.evaluate((label) => {
        const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, .cmplz-banner, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
        const bannerVisible = banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(banner).visibility !== 'hidden' : false;
        const cmplzCSS = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]'))
          .filter(l => /complianz/.test(l.href))
          .map(l => l.href);
        const cmplzScripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]'))
          .filter(s => /complianz|cmplz/.test(s.src))
          .map(s => s.src.replace(location.origin, ''));
        const acceptBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, .cmplz-btn-primary[data-cmplz_action="accept"], button.cmplz-accept');
        const denyBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, button.cmplz-deny');
        const manageBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-view-preferences, .cmplz-manage-options');
        const lang = document.documentElement.lang || 'unknown';
        return {
          label,
          url: location.href.replace(/\?.*$/, ''),
          html_lang: lang,
          banner_present: !!banner,
          banner_visible: bannerVisible,
          cmplz_css_count: cmplzCSS.length,
          cmplz_css_files: cmplzCSS.map(h => h.split('/').slice(-2).join('/')),
          accept_btn: acceptBtn ? acceptBtn.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40) : null,
          deny_btn: denyBtn ? denyBtn.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40) : null,
          manage_btn: manageBtn ? manageBtn.innerText.trim().slice(0, 40) : null,
          cmplz_status: typeof window.cmplz_user_data !== 'undefined' ? 'loaded' : 'not_loaded',
        };
      }, label);
    } catch (e) {
      return { label, error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 200) };
    }
  };

  const results = [];
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/', 'Blog 1 PT (home)'));
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/en/', 'Blog 1 EN (/en/)'));
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/', 'Blog 2 (/cultura/)'));

  return results;
}
)(page);

> AGENT

**HTTP 403 do AmazonS3** — o CloudFront está roteando `/uploads/sites/2/complianz/css/*` para o S3, não para a origem ALB. O behavior CF para `/wp-content/uploads/*` aponta para CloudFront-OAC + S3 (que tem só os uploads de mídia, não os CSS regenerados pelo Complianz no filesystem EC2).

Vou descobrir qual behavior trata esse path:

> TOOL

}

> AGENT

Confirmado. **`wp-content/uploads/*` → S3-uploads-prod** (CloudFront-OAC). O Complianz regenera CSS no filesystem EC2, mas o CF serve esse path do S3, que não contém os CSS regenerados.

**Solução:** sincronizar os Complianz CSS regenerados do filesystem EC2 → S3:

> TOOL

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  const ctx = page.context();
  await ctx.clearCookies();

  const checkUrl = async (url, label) => {
    const errors404 = [];
    page.on('response', resp => {
      if (resp.status() === 404 && /complianz|cmplz/.test(resp.url())) {
        errors404.push(resp.url().replace(location?.origin || '', ''));
      }
    });
    try {
      await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
      const result = await page.evaluate((label) => {
        const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner, .cmplz-banner, [class*="cmplz-banner"]');
        const bannerVisible = banner ? getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(banner).visibility !== 'hidden' : false;
        const cmplzCSS = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]'))
          .filter(l => /complianz/.test(l.href))
          .map(l => l.href.replace(location.origin, ''));
        const acceptBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept, .cmplz-btn-primary[data-cmplz_action="accept"], button.cmplz-accept');
        const denyBtn = document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny, button.cmplz-deny');
        return {
          label,
          html_lang: document.documentElement.lang,
          banner_visible: bannerVisible,
          cmplz_css: cmplzCSS,
          accept_btn: acceptBtn?.innerText?.trim().slice(0, 30) || null,
          deny_btn: denyBtn?.innerText?.trim().slice(0, 30) || null,
        };
      }, label);
      result.errors_404_complianz = errors404;
      return result;
    } catch (e) {
      return { label, error: (e.message || '?').slice(0, 200) };
    }
  };

  const results = [];
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/', 'Blog 1 PT'));
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/en/', 'Blog 1 EN'));
  results.push(await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/', 'Blog 2 PT'));

  return results;
}
)(page);
```

```js
await (async (page) => {
  await page.context().clearCookies();

  const checkUrl = async (url, label) => {
    const errors = [];
    page.removeAllListeners('response');
    page.on('response', resp => {
      if (resp.status() >= 400 && /complianz|cmplz/i.test(resp.url())) {
        errors.push(resp.status() + ' ' + resp.url().replace(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/, ''));
      }
    });
    await page.goto(url + '?cb=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
    const r = await page.evaluate((label) => {
      const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner');
      const visible = banner && getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(banner).visibility !== 'hidden';
      const cssLink = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')).find(l => /complianz\/css\/banner/.test(l.href));
      return {
        label,
        html_lang: document.documentElement.lang,
        banner_visible: !!visible,
        banner_css_url: cssLink ? cssLink.href.replace(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/, '') : null,
        accept_btn: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
        deny_btn: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
      };
    }, label);
    r.errors = errors;
    return r;
  };

  return [
    await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/', 'Blog 1 PT'),
    await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/en/', 'Blog 1 EN'),
    await checkUrl('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/', 'Blog 2 PT'),
  ];
}
)(page);
```

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  // Forçar bypass total de cache via interceptor
  await page.route('**/banner-1-optin.css*', route => {
    route.continue({ headers: { ...route.request().headers(), 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'Pragma': 'no-cache' } });
  });
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  
  const errors = [];
  page.on('response', resp => {
    if (resp.status() >= 400 && /complianz|cmplz/i.test(resp.url())) {
      errors.push(resp.status() + ' ' + resp.url().replace(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/, ''));
    }
  });

  await page.goto('https://concertacaoamazonia.com.br/cultura/?nocache=' + Date.now(), { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 45000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

  const result = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const banner = document.querySelector('.cmplz-cookiebanner');
    const visible = banner && getComputedStyle(banner).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(banner).visibility !== 'hidden';
    const cssLink = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')).find(l => /complianz\/css\/banner/.test(l.href));
    return {
      html_lang: document.documentElement.lang,
      banner_visible: !!visible,
      banner_position: banner ? {
        bottom: getComputedStyle(banner).bottom,
        right: getComputedStyle(banner).right,
        display: getComputedStyle(banner).display,
        visibility: getComputedStyle(banner).visibility,
        opacity: getComputedStyle(banner).opacity,
        zIndex: getComputedStyle(banner).zIndex,
      } : null,
      banner_classes: banner ? banner.className : null,
      banner_css_url: cssLink?.href?.replace(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/, '') || null,
      accept_btn: document.querySelector('.cmplz-accept')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
      deny_btn: document.querySelector('.cmplz-deny')?.innerText?.trim() || null,
    };
  });
  result.errors_complianz = errors;
  return result;
}
)(page);
```

**Pendências resolvidas nesta sessão:**

1. **Pendência 1 — Banner não aparece em `/en/`:** corrigido `cmplz_options.other_region_behavior = 'block' → 'show'` em ambos blogs (EN agora é tratada como região com banner)

2. **Pendência 2 — Blog 2 sem CSS de banner:** root cause era tabela `wp_2_cmplz_cookiebanners` vazia. Inserido banner ID=1 clonado de blog 1 via SQL + `generate_css()` + sync para S3 + invalidação CF

**Pendência remanescente (conhecida — não bloqueante):** banner em `/en/` mostra texto em PT ("ACEITAR/REJEITAR") por falta de string translations WPML para Complianz. Tradução textual é tarefa do agente `/wpml-translate` posteriormente.

Quer que eu commit os scripts/correções e ofereça `/schedule` para acompanhar a tradução EN do banner?
